mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph route to the tissue was most worthwhile because it showed a continuous path from around the cells back to a vein.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to join the tiny and larger lymph vessels was confusing because their pictures suggested a connection, but the required order was not clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the larger lymph vessels had to connect to the vein before they could join the tiny vessels.

arbitrary.text: The vein-first requirement felt arbitrary: the route makes sense once finished, but I did not understand why that connection had to come first.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how more body systems connect, although I would hope future prerequisites are clearer.
